disposition: The closed typed adapter exists and is exercised: PublicOperation is a closed registry (no route/body/bytes/SQL/handle/permission variant exists) and the focused tests prove generic payloads, generic routes, and private control-plane operations are rejected while one approved typed operation with stable identity is forwarded and answered. The row's compatibility clause (V1 wire compatibility proven per typed operation) remains an open proof obligation, not missing behavior; the boundary semantics themselves are implemented and tested.
